visualize_config_svg: generate an SVG visualization of a Concordia simulation config showing entities grouped by role
visualize_config_to_html: generate a complete HTML page with SVG visualization and interactive inspector for a simulation config
build_entity_data: build a dictionary of entity data from a simulation config for JavaScript inspector access
render_entity_svg: render a single entity instance config as SVG elements with component parameters and action area
get_component_items: extract component parameter key-value pairs from an instance config excluding the name parameter
